methodology.relevance: Heuristic keyword-overlap proxy; a chunk is marked relevant when at least one meaningful query token overlaps.
methodology.precision@6: Heuristic precision over the six returned results; not manually judged relevance.
methodology.recall@6: Requires a set of known relevant chunk IDs. Remains null until ground truth is supplied.
methodology.contextual_precision: Average precision calculated from the heuristic relevance labels and returned ranking.
methodology.recent_precision_and_historical_precisio: Heuristic topical relevance ratio within each database, not temporal classification accuracy.

recall@6.status: Not evaluated: supply ground_truth_relevant_ids to update_metrics().
